WITH status_counts AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(archstat, '<missing>') AS status, COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM scanqc
  GROUP BY COALESCE(archstat, '<missing>')
), shares AS (
  SELECT status, record_count,
         1.0 * record_count / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM status_counts
), scored AS (
  SELECT status, record_count, share,
         AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT status, record_count, share, share - average_share AS above_average_share
FROM scored
WHERE share > average_share;

assumptions.assumption: The literal status value '<missing>' is used to represent NULL; if that value already occurs in archstat, it is grouped with NULLs.
